glosses: Involving an outcome which is impossible to predict, but which may be represented by a probability distribution; in the ideal case, involving outcomes which are equally likely.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: aleatory, stochastic
The flip of a fair coin is purely random.
The newspaper conducted a random sample of five hundred American teenagers.
The results of the field survey look random by several different measures.
A toss of a loaded die is still random, though biased.

glosses: Pseudorandom; mimicking the result of random selection.

examples.text: The rand function generates a random number from a seed.

glosses: Selected for no particular reason; arbitrary; unspecified.

examples.text: A random American off the street couldn't tell the difference.
You're just going to trust the word of random people on the Internet?
I didn't have time to peruse the resturant's menu, so I just ordered some random dish.

glosses: Being (part of) a varied, unrelated, and apparently arbitrary collection of things; diverse, heterogeneous.

examples.text: My notebook has turned into a random collection of thoughts.
I brought a bunch of random snacks, but nothing nutritious.
I mixed a bunch of random vegetables into a salad, and it actually turned out pretty good.

glosses: Apropos of nothing; lacking context, relevance, or any connection to the previous situation; unexpected.

examples.text: This random guy just came up to me to say that he was a fan of my work.
Thank you for that completely random comment... now, let's get back to our actual topic of discussion.
The teacher's bartending story was interesting, but very random.
I feel like pineapple is a very random thing to put on a pizza.

glosses: Of a person: characterized by or often saying random things; habitually using non sequiturs.

examples.text: You're so random! I never know what you're going to do next.

glosses: Being out of the ordinary; unusual or unexpected; odd, strange, bizarre.

examples.text: That's a rather random fact!
I can't believe he would say that. That's so random!

glosses: To wander; to stray; to meander.
